breakdown.description: The torque-induced arc load is replaced by a fixed global-x traction instead of a tangential traction field
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The original error was to apply the traction as a fixed global-x vector. The ground truth corrects this by specifying the traction should be in the 'local tangent direction'. The agent's generated specification repeated the original error, stating to 'Impose the traction as a fixed Cartesian vector (t_θ, 0) on the arc, acting in the positive x‑direction'.
